title: Matrix Obtained By Rotation
description: Given two `n x n` integer matrices `mat` and `target`, return `true` if it is possible to make `mat` identical to `target` by rotating `mat` in 90-degree clockwise increments (0, 90, 180, or 270 degrees), or `false` otherwise.
hints: There are only 4 distinct orientations obtained by rotating 90 degrees clockwise: 0, 90, 180, and 270 degrees.
You can check all 4 orientations directly in a single pass using index mappings without allocating rotated copies.

examples.explanation: Rotating mat 90 degrees clockwise once matches target.
None of the four 90-degree rotations of mat equals target.
Rotating mat 180 degrees (twice by 90 degrees) matches target.
